summary: Describes Client Hints, a way for HTTP clients to proactively tell servers about their characteristics, such as device or network traits, using request header fields. This is an experimental approach to content negotiation that tries to balance performance against the privacy cost of sending extra information.

eli5.summary: Your browser tells a website a little about itself, like screen size, so the site can send the best version, but only when the site asks.

questions: how do servers request client information from browsers
